description: Provider-agnostic placeholder step for verification, KBA, and payment flows.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: Signing field represented by this step.

parameters.name: AnswersChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when KBA answers change.

parameters.name: AppearsOn
parameters.description: Short text describing where the field appears in the document.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the shell element.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve localized field text.

parameters.name: Error
parameters.description: Error message shown for the external provider operation.

parameters.name: ExternalUrl
parameters.description: External URL for provider-hosted verification or checkout.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized field text is missing.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Whether the external provider operation is loading.

parameters.name: OnCheckout
parameters.description: Callback invoked when payment checkout should start.

parameters.name: OnStart
parameters.description: Callback invoked when verification or KBA should start.
